title: The √|V| second-moment gap is the q^{n/2} 'union tax' that forces an L^∞ argument (W-Johnson relocated to base-point space via Plancherel duality)
reduced_to: The true (realized) bracket gap is max_{s0}‖𝒮‖^2 / M = B^2/n on the QUOTIENT V/⟨s1⟩, which equals the BGK ratio log(q/n) — i.e. the open core is the per-frequency BGK √-cancellation B = max_{b≠0}|Σ_{y∈μ_n} e_q(by)| ≤ ~√(n·log(q/n)) (generalized-Paley eigenvalue / face 3), NOT a base-point union tax.
wall: W-Johnson / BGK (generalized Paley eigenvalue B = max|η_b|; the project's face-3 wall, GeneralizedPaleyRamanujan.lean / CharSumMomentDeepWall.lean)
evidence: Two exact probes (scripts/probes/_407_conn/C054_bracket_gap.py = literal F_q^m modules; scripts/probes/_407_conn/C054_prize_regime.py = proper dyadic subgroups μ_n < F_q*, q=1 mod n, large prime, q≈n^4.5). (A) THE TWO BRICKS ARE GENUINE: shawError_sq_le_second_moment (max‖𝒮‖^2 ≤ |V|·M) and exists_shawError_sq_ge (∃ s0 ≥ M) are axiom-clean and DO bracket max‖𝒮‖^2 ∈ [M, |V|·M]; the average identity shawError_second_moment is exact (probe confirms avg_all = M to 1e-6 at every instance). The structural note 'argmax s0 is a coset of ⟨s1⟩' is also correct: #{s0 : |𝒮|^2 ≥ 0.5 max} = lineSize exactly (5,5,7) in the structured F_q^m runs. (B) THE HEADLINE INSIGHT (√|V| union tax = W-Johnson via Plancherel) IS REFUTED as a wall identification by the realized numbers. On F_q^m the TRUE gap max/M is 4,4,6,1.08,3.85 while the claimed upper bound |V| is 25,25,49,125,125 — ratio max/(|V|·M)=0.16,0.16,0.12,0.009,0.03 (never near 1). In the PRIZE REGIME the family η_b=Σ_{y∈μ_n} e_q(by) (= the Shaw per-frequency content on the hyperplane) gives, for n=8/16/32/64 at β=4.5 (q=11593/262193/5931649/134218433): B^2/avg = 7.37/12.63/18.85/25.76 (the GENUINE gap, ≈ B^2/n ≈ log(q/n)), whereas the claimed '√|V| tax'^2 = |V| = q = 11593/262193/5931649/134218433. The tax overshoot √q/B = 14×/36×/99×/285× and DIVERGES. Meanwhile B/√(n·log(q/n)) = 1.01/1.14/1.25/1.33 — the worst case sits firmly on the BGK √(n log) law, not on √q. L2 mass is exact by Parseval (M = q·n − n^2; probe matches).
honest_note: PARTIAL not REFUTED because the cited Lean lemmas and the 'worst-s0 is a line-coset' structural observation are genuine, machine-checked, and correctly stated; only the HEADLINE identification ('the √|V|=q^{n/2} base-point union tax IS W-Johnson relocated via Plancherel duality', and that closing the prize must 'save' this √|V| factor) is wrong. The upper brick shawError_sq_le_second_moment is just Finset.single_le_sum (one term ≤ the whole second moment), a TRIVIALLY loose bound, not a structural tax: it overshoots the true worst case by a factor √q/B that diverges (14×→85×→… as n grows). The actual obstruction is the SAME BGK per-frequency √-cancellation the project already names (face 3 = generalized-Paley eigenvalue B = max|η_b|, B/√(n log(q/n))≈1), i.e. the connection welds back to W-Johnson/BGK but MIS-LOCATES it: the genuine gap is the QUOTIENT-Plancherel ratio B^2/n = log(q/n) on the |V|/|F| effective base points, never the full-group √|V|. No closure of anything; the probes are exact (roots-of-unity sums; L2 mass cross-checked against Parseval q·n−n^2; prize instances are bona-fide proper-subgroup large primes, avoiding the #400 full-group trap).
